state_summary.problem: Leaving an explanation opened from the title after reload can overwrite the actual unfinished saved deal with the preview board.
state_summary.expected: Explanations opened from title do not create or replace normal saved runs; the existing saved deal and its telemetry run identity remain unchanged.
observed: Code inspection: new page initializes game as a title-preview Klondike while SolitaireStore retains the genuine snapshot.
explain(false) changes state to explanation without restoring the saved game.
save accepts any non-title/non-training state; both pagehide and returnToPortal call it in explanation.
unknown: Browser reproduction has not yet been measured.
state_summary.operation: Save normal deal → reload → explanation from title → reload or Portal

codex_independent_judgment.rationale: The global live game starts as a different preview snapshot on reload, and save() uses display state rather than normal-run provenance. A title explanation can trigger persistence of that unrelated board. This loses a resumable deal and its existing run identity. Browser checks should confirm both reload and explicit Portal paths before and after narrowing the save boundary.

actual_next_action.description: Reproduced original save overwrite using native new deal/draw/reload/title explanation then reload and Portal. Applied root-authorized narrow provenance guard. Four fixed regressions include restored normal explanations, and all preserve seed/UUID/position/history. Additional independent model simulation, typecheck, build and four-viewport full native fixture clear validate surrounding behavior.
